effect.name: GM Emulsion Halation
effect.desc: Warm film-stock highlight bleed driven by luminance rather than alpha.
effect.shader: const vec3 L=vec3(0.2126,0.7152,0.0722); float hi(vec4 c){return smoothstep(threshold,threshold+0.25,dot(c.rgb,L));} void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm;vec2 p=radius/inputImg.size;vec4 s=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);float h=0.18*hi(s);h+=0.1025*(hi(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv+vec2(p.x,0.0)))+hi(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv-vec2(p.x,0.0)))+hi(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv+vec2(0.0,p.y)))+hi(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv-vec2(0.0,p.y))));h+=0.1025*(hi(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv+p))+hi(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv-p))+hi(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv+vec2(p.x,-p.y)))+hi(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv+vec2(-p.x,p.y))));gl_FragColor=vec4(s.rgb+tint.rgb*h*strength,s.a);}
